text: Feeling anxious about being diagnosed with a heart condition.
You're not alone.
Anxiety is common amongst people living with heart disease.
It's more than a stressful occasion that passes.
Anxiety is ongoing.
Worries that impact how you live your daily life.
You may be unable to control anxious thoughts,
find it hard to keep calm,
feel tired easily and have trouble concentrating.
The good news. Anxiety is manageable.
Taking simple steps like deep breathing,
going for a walk,
or practicing mindfulness can calm mind and body.
You don't have to face this alone.
Talk to your doctor,
seek support with a psychologist,
and join the Heart Foundation's My Heart, My Life Facebook community
to connect with others sharing a similar experience.
Visit the Heart Foundation website for tools and support
to care for both your mental health and heart health.
